page.layout: Left printed page: running head at top; page number 140 at left of head; one text column with margin notes in the left margin (the notes are short and sit beside lines 4 and 17). Right printed page, at the right edge: running head at top and one text column, cut off at the right edge, with only the beginnings of lines readable.; One column of running text, with marginal notes in the left margin (a section number and a reference). Text ends with a hyphenated word at the foot of the column. No running head or page number visible. A narrow strip at the right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: retundunt, instructas acies in fugam vertunt, tuam etiam Imperator impietatem compressurae sunt etiam si ad aliquod tempus extollaris.] Dolebant, & lachrymabantur, (inquit {b}Chrysostomus) in malis quae tunc fiebant, quasi uniuerso mundo tutores dati essent, & ibidem in Martyrum Iuuentini & Maximi persona loquens: Aripiamus, inquit, arma spiritualia, non opus jaculis & sagittis? &c. Sed quid interim de hoc Apostata Episcopi Ecclesiae luminaria? Lyberius hoc ipso tempore Episcopus Romanus, ad {c}Athanasium literas dedit, sed de Imperatore excommunican-Serm.in Iuuentinum & Maximum tom.3.Rufinus lib.1.cap.

Gregs… fale … [c eo … man … quib … præf … lexa … (qu… Par… Epi… tan… qua… mo… tun… me 3o.do,aut deponendo,ne verbum quidem, multò minùs trucidando: Imò ipse Athanasius, ex Alexandriâ Imperatoris mandato profugere coactus, in eos qui illum circumsistentes mœrebant & difcessum ejus grauiter ferebant, oculis coniectis:[{d}bono estote animo filioli, inquit, nubecula est, breui euanescet.] Quasi dixisset; non ipsi eam dissoluite, sed ejus dissolutionem maturè cuenturam expectate. Post Imperatoris interitum, duas quidem Invectiuas in eum scripsit Gre-Socrat.li. 3.cap.12.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "retundunt" and "Aripiamus" as printed; "Lyberius" and "Athanasium" are set in italic. Right-hand printed page: only the beginnings of its lines are readable, and its running head reads only "Li"; the readings there are tentative. Printed "Lib.III" in the running head is the book number and is not part of the title. The left margin notes are set in italic, the second one is continued below. Marginal note "d Socrat.li. 3.cap.12." is keyed to the reference mark d before "bono". The word "cuenturam" is read with some doubt. The word after "Gre-" is not on this part of the page.
